name: qr-code
title: Qr Code
description: A QR code for a link or a short text, drawn as one SVG path from the pure encoder in `qr-model.ts`. No dependency, no canvas, no image request: it renders on the server and stays sharp at any size, from a phone card to a projector.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/qr-code

Installed to `components/ui/games/qr-code.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/qr-code';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/qr-code

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
